{{Quote|Captain, what's going on? Report.''"''<br />''"''We have successfully destroyed the main computer core, sir.|Tol Sivron and the stormtrooper captain during the Battle of the Maw|<ref name="CotF" />}}
This '''stormtrooper captain''' served aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Maw Installation]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I have had some experience flying attack vehicles, sir. Perhaps I can interpret the controls.|The stormtrooper captain offering to pilot the Death Star prototype|<ref name="CotF" />}}
At some point prior to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] this stormtrooper [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was assigned to the Empire's secret think tank, the Maw Installation, within [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. For over ten years, the captain and rest of the Installation's personnel had no contact with the rest of the galaxy.<ref name="CotF" />

When a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] strike force lead by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antillies]] arrived at the Installation, the captain was in charge of coordinating the defense of the facility, placing [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|troops]] at several key strategic points throughout its hallways. He was also tasked with destroying the facility's main computer in order to erase information useful to the New Republic. Eventually, the captain and several other Maw Installation personnel evacuated to the nearby [[Death Star prototype]]. Having prior [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] experience, he flew the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] through [[Maw Cluster/Legends|The Maw]] and back during the [[Battle of the Maw|Battle of Maw Installation]] and the concurrent [[Battle of Kessel (11 ABY)|Battle of Kessel]].<ref name="CotF" />

[[File:Death_Star_Prototype_destruction.jpg|thumb|200px|right|The Death Star prototype's destruction and the stormtrooper captain's subsequent death.]]
When the [[Sun Crusher]] piloted by [[Kyp Durron]] arrived and began to fire on the battlestation, Maw Installation's [[Chief Administrator/Legends|Chief Administer]], [[Tol Sivron]], took the controls from the captain and chased the tiny ship around the Maw as the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] fired. The stormtrooper captain was killed, along with everyone else onboard the prototype Death Star when Durron lured it close to a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]], causing it to be caught in its [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] pull and sucked in.<ref name="CotF" />
